verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. גרר) arrastar, carregar consigo .; ser gerado indiretamente.; deixar um pente (גֵּרוּם) ao cortar uma medida, de onde (no abate ritual) cortar em uma direção inclinada, para deixar a faca deslizar além do espaço prescrito para o corte.
definicoes_originais: (v. גרר) to drag along, carry with it.
to leave a comb (גֵּרוּם) in striking a measure off, whence (in ritual slaughtering) to cut in a slanting direction, to let the knife slide beyond the space prescribed for cutting.
notas_originais: —Part. pass. גָּרוּם added in boot, additional measure, v. גֵּירוּמִין.—אַמָּה גְּרוּמָה a large cubit. Gen. R. s. 12 [read:] כאמה ג' the size of a liberal cubit (equal to a cubit and a half of strict measure; some ed. גד'; vers. in ‘Rashi’ a. l. גרמידא ומחצה).—Y. Shek. VI, end, 50 b אמה גרו', read גְּדוּמָה, v. גָּדַם. [Tosef. Bekh. V, 4 אצבעותיו גרומות Var., ed. Zuck. גְּדוּמֹות.]—Trnsf. to carry with it, to be the cause of, to engender. דבר הגֹּורֵם לממון something which may be the cause of pecuniary profit or loss. B. Kam. 71 b if one steals objects dedicated to the sanctuary for which the original owner is responsible in case of loss &c., he is bound to pay the thief’s fine (כֵּפֶל) to the owner; אלמא דבר הג' למ' כממון דמי which proves that that which may cause a pecuniary loss, is to be considered as the property of him to whom it may cause it. Ib. 98 b according to the opinion of R. Shimeon who says דבר הגורם … מיחייב that what is the cause of monetary gain is considered as money, he who burns a note of indebtedness is bound to pay the full amount of the note; a. fr.—Snh. 104 a גורם גלות לבניו causes his children to be exiled. Ber. 5 b bot. ג' לשכינה וכ' is the cause of the Divine Presence departing from Israel. M. Kat. 25 a בבל גָּרְמָה לו Babylonia was the cause (that the Shekhinah did not rest upon him). Ab. Zar. 8 b bot. המקום גורם the place makes the act legal, i.e. only in the Temple hall can the Sanhedrin judge capital cases; Snh. 14 b המקום ג' only in the Temple hall can a rebellious elder be judged; ib. 87 a.—Y. Yeb. I, 2 c top דבר שהוא בא מחמת הגורם וכ' if a prohibition arises from a cause (a person that causes it, e.g. the prohibition against C.’s marrying B. because B.’s sister A. is his wife)—when the cause is removed (through A.’s death), the prohibition ceases; but a prohibition which has not its cause in the action of a person (but in natural kinship, e.g. C.’s daughter married to C.’s brother whereby she becomes forbidden to him also as his brother’s wife), is not removed with the removal of the cause of the (additional) prohibition, i.e. C. cannot perform the levir’s marriage with his brother’s wife since she has not ceased to be his daughter; ib. III, beg., 4 c; IV, 6 a top.—זה וזה גורם a product of combined causes. Tem. 30 b זה וזה ג' אסור a product of combined causes is forbidden, e.g. the offspring of a dam unfitted for the altar, and of a sire fit; Pes. 27 a; a. fr.—Ib. 26 b זה וזה ג' מי שמעת ליה can you prove that Rabbi adopts the rule forbidding the product of combined causes?—Nidd. 31 a (homiletical play on Gen. XLIX, 14) חמור ג' ליששכר the braying of an ass was the cause of Isachar being begotten; Gen. R. s. 99; v. next w.
same. Gen. R. s. 39 הדרך מְגָרֶמֶת וכ' traveling is the cause of three evils.
Ab. Zar. 55 b אסור לִיגָּרֵם וכ' no assistance must be given to making unclean &c.
Ḥull. 19 a; 20 a; a. fr.—Part. pass. f. מוּגְרֶמֶת an animal slaughtered by a slanting cut. Ib. 18 b; a. fr.—Denom. הַגְרָמָה.

notas_originais: Targ. Is. III, 9; a. fr.—Meg. 12 b אנא גַּרְמִי וכ' Ms. M. (ed. גרים) I am the cause that M. was born. Ber. 7 b שמא גָרֵים a person’s name has an influence on his fate or character. verbetes.glosa_atual: (denominação de גַּרְמָא, cmp. עצם) ser substancial, forte.; fortalecer, confortar.; comer até os ossos, arrancar.; para tornar substancial, endurecer.

to eat up to the bone, to pick off.

XXXVIII, 4 [read:] גּוּמְרַיָּא וְגַרְמַיָּא or גורמיא וגומריא, v. supra.—B. Bath. 58 a חביתא דג' a vessel of bones (an enigmatical phrase for an animal). ג' ג' each for itself, one after the other. Ib. 11 b. Ḥull. 113 a.—With suffixes of personal pronouns: גַּרְמִי myself &c. Targ. Job I, 3 לגַרְמֵיה as his own, לגֶרֶם אתתיה (Ms. לגְרַם) as his wife’s sole property. Targ. Y. Lev. VII, 29 בגַרְמֵיה himself; a. fr.—Gen. R. s. 75, beg., v. גַּפָּא I. Y. Ber. definicoes_originais: (cmp. גרר, גּוֹרֶן) to scrape together; to collect, accumulate.
notas_originais: Denom. גּוּרְסִינָא. [Targ. Prov. XVIII, 10; V, 19, v. גְּרַם II.]—Trnsf. to acquire knowledge, to commit traditions to memory, as a preliminary stage to speculation and analysis compared to grinding, v. טחן. Ab. Zar. 19 a לעולם יגמר ואע"ג דמשכח ולִיגְרַס ואע"ג דלא ידע וכ' Ms. M. one must at all events acquire readiness (v. גְּמַר II), though one may afterwards forget, and one must study by heart though one does not understand, for Holy Writ says (Ps. CXIX, 20) gar’sah &c.; it says גָרְסָה and not טָחֲנָה (my soul heaps up, but not it grinds, learns but not analyzes); (ed. לִיגְרִיס, and other Variants); Yalk. Ps. 876.—Ber. 8 a הוה גְרִיסְנָא בגו ביתאי Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) I used to study in my house; Meg. 29 a. Ber. l. c. bot. turned his face וגריס and reviewed (what he had learned). Taan. 10 b למִיגְרַס to recite traditions, opp. לעיוני to speculate. Ber. 13 b (ref. to Deut. XI, 18, v. Targ. Y. a. l.) teach your children …, כי היכי דלִיגְרְסוּ בהו (Ms. M. ונִגְרְסוּ בהו) so that they be able to review them (by themselves); a. fr.— Part. act. גָּרֵיס well-versed, knowing by heart. B. Bath. 21 a ג' ולא דייק knowing Bible verses by heart, but being inexact.— Part. pass. גְּרִיס, f. גְּרִיסָא known by heart. Men. 32 b מיגרס גְּרִיסִין; Meg. 18 b מיגרס גְּרִיסָן they are known by heart.

verbetes.glosa_atual: v. גרר) raspar, diminuir, deduzir.; deduzir, calcular o preço do resgate proporcionalmente aos anos cumpridos e aos que serão cumpridos, v. גֵּירוּעַ Kidd. 11 b מַגְרַעַת מפדיונה ela faz uma dedução do dinheiro do seu resgate; eu.; a ser deduzido, a ser resgatado mediante dedução da indenização pelo tempo cumprido.
definicoes_originais: v. גרר) to scrape off, to diminish, deduct.

to deduct from, to calculate the price of redemption in proportion to the years served and those to be served, v. גֵּירוּעַ Kidd. 11 b מַגְרַעַת מפדיונה she makes a deduction from her redemption money; ib.
to be deducted, to be redeemed by deducting the compensation for the time served.
notas_originais: Snh. 29 a כל המוסיף גּוֹרֵעַ he who adds (to the truth) diminishes (whoever does too much does too little). R. Hash. 28 b, a. fr. עובר על בל תִּגְרַע transgresses the law which prohibits diminishing from what the Law prescribes (Deut. XIII, 1, v. בַּל). Yoma 48 a גּוֹרְעִין ומוסיפין ודורשין we may take away (one servile letter from one word of the text) and add it to another and thus interpret the law (e.g. מדם הפר explained as: דם מהפר); B. Bath. 111 b; a. fr.—Y. Yeb. VIII, end, 9 d, v. גָּלַע.—[Gen. R. s. 19, a. e. גרעה קומתו, v. גָּוַע.]— Part. pass. גָּרוּעַ inferior. Pl. גְּרוּעִים. Gen. R. s. 28. [Ber. 36 a ומי גרע, read with Ms. M. גריעי.]
14 b מגרעת פדיונה she lessens &c.; ib. 16 a מגרע פד' (corr. acc.). Y. Kidd. I, 58 c bot.; Y. Shebu. VI, beg. 36 d מגרעת (ב)מעה וכ' she redeems herself by deducting a M’ah for each year.

Y. Kidd. l. c. אם בקשה לִיגָּרֵעַ if the desires a redemption by deduction &c.; Y. Shebu. l. c. למיגרע (read: לֵהִיגָּ' or לִיגָּ'). Kidd. 11 b תִּיגָּרֵעַ עד פרוטה she can redeem herself by deductions until she comes down to a P’rutah.

definicoes_originais: , esp. to shave, cut the hair (dialectically interchanging with גרד).
as preced. Hif. [Targ. Y. II Gen. XXX, 11, read מגדעא.
as preced. Nif. Arakh. 30 b מִיגְּרְעָא ואזלא his obligation grows less (every year, if he chooses to redeem her).
notas_originais: Targ. Jud. XVI, 19; II Sam. X, 4 Ar. (ed. גדע, ed. Lag. II Sam. l. c. גרע; cmp. Is. XV, 2, Jer. XLVIII, 37).—Lam. R. to I, 1 ג' רישיה (8 חד מאת') רבתי he shaved his head. Snh. 96 a (prov.) גְּרַעְתֵּיה לארמאה וכ' Ar. (ed. גרירתיה, Ms. M. גרידתיה) if you shave a gentile, he likes it; hang fire on his beard, and you will get no end of his fun (i.e. if he finds it convenient, he will submit to indignities).—Part. pass. גְּרִיעַ, f. גְּרִיעָא
. Lam. R. l. c.
Yeb. 51 a ג' ממאמר is inferior (as to legal power) to &c., v. מַאֲמָר. Gitt. 70 a ג' דכולהו the worst of all.
] Kidd. 11 b מַגְרְעָה ואזלה she deducts more and more every year. Ib. [read:] מאי מגרעה what is there for her to deduct from?—Arakh. 25 a, v. infra.
Ib. 25 a לא מִגְּרַע ליה (Rashi מיג') no deduction is allowed him (for fractions of a year).

definicoes_originais: (denom. of גרעין) to form globules (one of the early stages of development of the grape).
notas_originais: Denom. גַּרְעִין.

Shebi. IV, 10 גפנים מִשֶּׁיְּגָרְעוּ grape vines (must not be cut down in the Sabbath year) from the moment they form stones, Maim.; oth. opin. ovules containing moisture; Y. ib. IV, end 35 c משיַגְרִיעוּ (Hif.), defined משיזחלו מים, with ref. to Job XXXVI, 27; Ber. 63 b; Pes. 52 b sq. משיגריעו (Ms. M. 2 משיגרעו).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גרע I) raspador, barbeiro, em gen. cirurgião de classe baixa, carta de sangue etc. Criança. 82a.
definicoes_originais: (גרע I) scraper, barber, in gen. low class surgeon, blood-letter &c. Kidd. 82 a.
notas_originais: Kel. XII, 4; Tosef. ib. B. Mets. II, 11 גָּרוֹעַ, v. מַסְמָר.
, v. גֵּירָ'

verbetes.glosa_atual: c. (v. גָּרַע II) glóbulo, esp. o caroço ou caroço de uma fruta com caroço, noz etc. - Pl. גַּרְעִינִין, גַּלְעִינִין, גַּרְאִי'.
definicoes_originais: c. (v. גָּרַע II) globule, esp. the stone or kernel of a stone fruit, nut &c.— Pl. גַּרְעִינִין, גַּלְעִינִין, גַּרְאִי'.
notas_originais: Sabb. VII, 4 (76 b) גרעינין Ms. M. (ed. גַּרְעִינֵיהֶן); Y. ed. גַּלְעִינֵיהֶן. Bab. ib. 77 b top, question as to spelling with א or ע (decided by ref. to ונגרע Lev. XXVII, 18). Shebi. VII, 3 גל'. Ter. XI, 5 גַּרְעִינֵי תרומה (Ms. M. גל') stones of fruits which are the priest’s share. Tosef. ib. X, 1; a. fr. V. גַּרְעִינָה.
, v. גַּרְעִינוּתָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: f. = גַּרְעִין (substantivo colecionado, usado promiscuamente com גַּרְעִינִין). Reino Unido. II, 2 גל' של רוטב os caroços das azeitonas úmidas; Y. Ter. XI, 47d bot. גלעיני הרוטב. Y. Maasr. I, 48 d.b.; um. frag.
notas_originais: f. = גַּרְעִין (collect. noun, used promiscuously with גַּרְעִינִין). Ukts. II, 2 גל' של רוטב the stones of moist olives; Y. Ter. XI, 47 d bot. גלעיני הרוטב. Y. Maasr. I, 48 d bot.; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: f. cap. mesmo. Ber. 39 a גַּרְעִינוּתֵיה (Sra. M. גַּרְעִינֵיח) os caroços (de uma azeitona).
notas_originais: f. ch. same. Ber. 39 a גַּרְעִינוּתֵיה (Ms. M. גַּרְעִינֵיח) the stones (of an olive).

definicoes_originais: v. גרר) to scrape, sweep, esp .
notas_originais: to remove ashes and coal from the stove; to scrape together, collect. Kel. VIII, 11 היתה גֹורְפָתֹו if while she was sweeping it (the stove) &c. Sabb. III, 1 עד שיִגְרֹוף not before he has swept it.—Y. Peah VII, 20 b top (ref. to Joel I, 17) תחת שהיינו גֹורְפִים וכ' in place of collecting honey (from beehives or trees), we collected foul matter. Sabb. XVII, 2 לִגְרֹוף בה וכ' to grab with it the figs out of the barrel; a. fr.—Gen. R. s. 67 גּוֹרֶפֶת מחוטמה blowing her nose (v. גָּרַר).— Part. pass. גָּרוּף, f. גְּרוּפָה cleared of ashes &c., swept. Sabb. III, 4, v. אַנְטִיכִי; a. fr.—[Gen. R. s. 53 ג' מביתו של וכ' (Isaac is) the refuse of &c., comment.; v., however, גְּרֹוף.]
same. Kerith. 7 b; Y. Snh. VII, 25 b top, v. גָּדַף

Targ. II Esth. III, 8 גרפין חמיעא they remove leavened things.—Y. Pes. II, end, 29 c גְּרֹוף מן תוחתיהון scrape them at the bottom. Y. Bets. IV, 62 c bot. [read:] איזלי גַרְפִין go thou and sweep them (the stones) out. Y. M. Kat. I, 80 b bot.; a. fr.
Targ. II Esth. l. c.
same. Targ. Job VII, 12 like the Ocean דמִתְגַּרְגֵּף וכ' Ms. which, at certain times, is swept (pours itself out over the shores; ed. דמתרגיף, v. רְגַף).
, v. גְּרֹופִית
, v. גּוּהַרְקָא II

verbetes.glosa_atual: v. גָּרָה) [para produzir um som áspero e raspado]; coçar, raspar, raspar (v. גָּרַד, גָּרַע I).; arrastar, mover-se sem levantar; (também verbo neutro) seguir.; levar consigo, causar; afetar (v. גָּרַם).
definicoes_originais: v. גָּרָה) [ to produce a grating, scraping sound,]
to scratch, scrape, shave (v. גָּרַד, גָּרַע I).
to drag, to move without lifting; (also neut. verb) to follow.
to carry with it, to cause; to affect (v. גָּרַם).
notas_originais: Sabb. VIII, 6 (81 a) כדי לִגְרֹור וכ' (Ar. a. Y. ed. לגרוד) large enough to scrape with it the top &c. R. Hash. 27 b גְּרָרֹו Ms. M. (ed. גרדו), v. גֶּלֶד. Keth. 60 a; Kerith. 21 b גֹּורְרֹו וכ' he must scrape the blood off before eating the bread; a. fr.—Part. pass. גָּרוּר, v. גָּרוּד.

Sabb. 29 b, a. fr. גורר אדם וכ' one may, on the Sabbath, pull or push a couch &c. (on the floor). Y. Kil. I, 27 b bot. לא יָגֹור אדם וכ' one must not pull &c. Tanḥ. Thazr. 8 גְּרָרוּהוּ מקברו they dragged him out of his grave. Tosef. Erub. XI (VIII), 13; Tosef. Bets. II, 19 דלת הגֹּורֶרֶת … הגֹּורְרִים (Y. Erub. X, 26 b bot. גודרת, corr. acc., v. גָּדַר) a door which drags along the ground (on opening), a matting which is moved by dragging, or large kegs which &c.; Erub. 101 a דלת הנִגְרֶרֶת … הנִגְרָר. Cant R. to II, 15 אני גֹורְרוֹ למבולו I will drag him to the flood in which to perish; a. fr.—Tanḥ. Thazr. 9 (ref. to Ps. V, 5 יגרך) אין אתה נגרר … ואין הרעה גֹורֶרֶת אותך וכ' neither art thou dragged behind (attracted by) evil, nor does evil drag (have power over) thee, nor does it dwell with thee; Yalk. Kings 231 אין אתה גורר אחר … גוררת אחריך.—Part. pass. גָּרוּר dragged along, hanging on.— Pl. גְּרוּרִים, גְּרוּרִין. Num. R. s. 18 ח' ג' eight threads dragged along (as fringes; Tanḥ. Korah 12 ח' חוטין). Ab. Zar. 3 b, a. e. גרים ג' proselytes who have attached themselves but have not been admitted, v. גֵּר.

Y. Hor. I, 46 a bot.; Y. Pes. VII, 34 c שבט אחד גֹּורֵר וכ' (a majority of) one tribe affects the legal status of the entire nation, i.e. the majority of tribes (seven) decides, though it may be a minority of the people as a whole. Lev. R. s. 13, end (play on gerah, Lev. XI, 4 sq.) גָּרְרָה מלכות וכ' carried another government after it, i.e. was followed by another oppressive government. Ab. IV, 2 מצוה גֹורֶרֶת וכ' a good deed begets a good deed &c. Tosef. Sabb. XV (XVI), 6 [read:] אין גֹּורֵר וכ' it is not considered a corpse so as to cause uncleanness to man or vessels.

Sabb. XVII, 2 (122 b) a saw (may be used on the Sabbath) לָגֹור בה וכ' (Ms. M. לִגְרֹור, Mish. ed. Pes. לגָרֵר, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) to saw cheese with it. Ohol. XV, 8 עתיד לָגֹור Ar. intended to be sawed apart (ed. לגוד, fr. גדד, v. Tosef. ib. XV, 8). Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 18 לָגֹור וכ' to saw off a part &c.

Erub. X, 11 נגר הנג' a bolt which is dragged along (with the door, i.e. attached and hanging down). Ib. 101 a, v. supra. Tanḥ. Thazr. 9, v. supra. Bets. II, 10 (23 b) אינה נִגְרֶרֶת; ib. אין נִגְרָרִין must not be dragged or pulled, a. fr.
B. Kam. 119 b הנ' במגירה shavings, opp. נפסק במגירה chips.—Nidd. 55 b נִגְרָרִין דרך הפה (secretions of the nose) scraped (discharged) through the mouth (v. גָּרַף).

Pes. IV, 9 (56 a) ג' עצמות וכ' he had the bones of his father carried out on a bed of ropes. Ib. I, 2 (9 a); a. fr.—Tosef. Sabb. VI (VII), 1 (a superstitious custom) המְגָרֶרֶת בנה וכ' Var. (ed. Zuck. המגוררת) one who drags her son among the dead (to the cemetery).

Ib. XVI (XVII), 19 מְגָרְרָן he may scrape them (clean his feet of mud). Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 17; Ḥull. 25 a עתיד … לגָרֵר requiring planing for finish; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְגֹורָר a) scratched, full of scabs. Gen. R. s. 64 (play on מגרר, Gen. XXVI, 26) ד"א מג' וכ' another explanation is m’gorar, for eruptions grew on him (with ref. to Job II, 8); Yalk. ib. 111; v. גָּרַר II. b) planed. Tosef. Sot. XV, 1 מְגֹורָרוֹת במגר' היו Var. (ed. Zuck. היה מְגָרֵר) the stones were planed with a plane.

Tosef. Sabb. XVI (XVII), 19 אין מִתְגָּרְרִין במגוררת ed. Zuck. (Var. מגרדין במגרדת, Sabb. 147 b גוררין במגררת, Ms. M. גודרין במגדירה, corr. acc.) one must not be scraped with a strigil. Ib. XXII, 6 (147 a) מתגררין, Talm. ed. (Mish. מִתְגָּרְדִין, v. Rabb. D. S. to 147 b, note 70).

verbetes.glosa_atual: ;; arrastar, puxar, empurrar.; arranhar, raspar.; esfregar, para abrir o apetite.
definicoes_originais: to rub, to whet the appetite.
notas_originais: —Part. pass. גְּרִיר dragged, following, guided by. Targ. Y. II Ex. XIV, 25 גְּרֵירַן וכ' (some ed. גריד') pushed from behind.—B. Kam. 18 b בתר גופיה גְּרִירִין they are clinging to his body. Taan. 24 a אנן בתרייהו גרירין Rashi (ed. גררינן, read גְּרִירִינָן, Ms. M. קאזלינן) we must be guided by their order. Ab. Zar. 72 b all the wine in the barrel אגישתא … ג' moves towards the siphon. B. Mets. 85 a דג' עלמא וכ' that all the world followed David.
Targ. Jud. VIII, 16, v. גְּרַד.—Ḥull. 83 b ולִיגְרְרֵיה ונכסי (Ar. גרד) let him scrape off the blood and cover it. Ib. ונִגְרֹור.— Part. גָּרֵיר Ib.

Ber. 35 b כי היכי דנִגְרְרֵיה לליביה (Ar. everywhere גרד) in order to stimulate his appetite. Ib. טובא גָרֵיר a large quantity has an appetizing effect. Pes. 107 b מִגְרַר גָּרֵיר. Sabb. 140 b משום דג' because it stimulates the appetite.

Esth. R. to I, 9 [read:] אנא מְגָרֵיר וכ' I will make their drinks appetizing (induce them to get intoxicated, interpreting Jer. LI, 39; differ. in comment.).—2) to saw off. Targ. Y. Deut. XXXIII, 20 דמְגָרֵר וכ' (or דמַגְרַר Af., ed. דמִגְרַר, corr. acc.) for he cuts off the arm &c. (II מַפְרַק).
Y. Kidd. I, 60 d large bags דארחיהון מִתְגָּרְרָה which are commonly dragged (not lifted).
Targ. Ps. XXII, 8 מִתְגָּרְרִין (some ed. מִתְגָּרְדִין, ed. Lag. מִתְגָּרִין, fr. גרי; h. text יפטירו).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (fr. um Polel de גּוּר; cmp. גָּלַל) rolar; cmp. גַּרְגַּר.; , Hitpol.
definicoes_originais: (fr. a Polel of גּוּר; cmp. גָּלַל) to roll; cmp. גַּרְגַּר.
notas_originais: —Part. pass. מְגוֹרָר whirled, reeling. Gen. R. s. 64 (play on מגרר, Gen. XXVI, 26) מג' … שנכנסו וכ' reeling (after a night revel) &c.; v. גָּרַר I.

הִתְגּוֹרֵר (v. Jer. XXX, 23, cmp. XXIII, 19) to roll one’s self, esp. (cmp. חָבַט II, חָנַן, נָפַל Hithpa.) to lie in contrition, asking forgiveness. Mekh. B’shall., Vayassa 1, [read as in] Yalk. Ex. 256 (ref. to וישלך אל המים, Ex. XV, 25, as if meaning, ‘and he caused them to throw themselves down in contrition over their sin by the sea-side’). היו ישראל מתחננים ומִתְגָּרְרִים … כבן שהוא מתחנן לפני אביו וכתלמיד שמִתְגּוֹרֵר לפני רבו כך היו ישראל מתחננין ומִתְגּוֹרְרִין וכ' the Israelites prayed beseechingly and rolled themselves in contrition before &c.
, v. גֶּרֶד
Targ. Y. II Deut. XIV, 6 sq. (some ed. גְּרָדָא).

definicoes_originais: (a Greek formation fr. גְּרָר, LXX Γέραροι) Gerariké, the district of G’rar in Philistea. Targ. Y. Gen. XX, 1 (Ar. a. Lev. גרדקי, corr. acc., ed. גְּרָר); ib.
notas_originais: XXVI, 1.—Gen. R. s. 64 גרדיקי (corr. acc.); Y. Shebi. VI, 36 c bot. גרריקו (corr. acc.).
, Y. Dem. I, 21 d, v. גדודתה

verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.); agitar, causar comoção.; (cmp. טָרַד) banir; despedir-se, divorciar-se (uma esposa).; mandar embora, banir.
definicoes_originais: to stir up, to set in commotion.
(cmp. טָרַד) to banish; to send off, divorce (a wife).
to be banished; to be divorced.
to be stirred up, become muddy, thick.
notas_originais: Sifré Deut. 39; Yalk. ib. 859 יכול יהו מים גּוֹרְשִׁין את העפר ממקום בקעה וכ' you might suppose the (rain) water will stir up the (fat) ground of the valley, and thus the valley will lack (drinking) water.
—Part. pass. גָּרוּשׁ, f. גְּרוּשָׁה q. v.

Gen. R. s. 21.—Esp. to give a letter of divorce. Gitt. IX, 1 הַמְּגָרֵשׁ וכ' if one divorces his wife and says, on handing her the letter, &c.; a. v. fr.—Ib. VI, 5 if one says (to his delegates) … גָּרְשׁוּהָ ga’rshuha, they are authorized to write and deliver to her a letter of divorce ( geresh being the colloquial term for divorcing).

El. ch. XIX; XX ג' ויצא וכ' he was banished and he left paradise.— Part. מְגוּרָשׁ, f. מְגוּרֶשֶׁת. Gitt. VII, 4 מג' ואינה מג' she is and is not divorced, i.e. her divorce is doubtful, and she has to suffer the disqualifications of a married and of a divorced woman. Ib. 5; a. v. fr.
נִתְגָּרֵשׁ
Midr. Till. to Ps. XCII. Gitt. 65 a מִתְגָּרֶשֶׁת בקידושי וכ' she is entitled to receive a letter of divorce for herself even though her father had contracted the marriage in her behalf; a. v. fr. [
Midr. d’R. Akiba, Alef (Jellinek Beth Hammidrash III, 13).]

Pa. גָּרֵישׁ. Pes. 110 b דגָרְשָׁהּ לאיתתיה Ms. M. (ed. דגרשא, corr. acc.) who had divorced his wife. Ber. 56 a תרי נשי מְגָרְשׁת it will be thy destiny to divorce two wives. Arakh. 23 a דלִיגָרֵש לדביתהו that he should divorce &c. Ib. אטו כל דמִגָרֵשׁ וכ' does every one who divorces his wife, give divorce in court?; a. fr.
אִיגְּרוּשֵׁי to be divorced. Gitt. 78 a בת אי' in a fit condition to receive a letter of divorce.

definicoes_originais: (cmp. גרר to drag) to hoist up.
notas_originais: Y. Kil. IX, 32 c top. Y. Keth. XII, 35 b top [read:] ואין עניית אתון גרשין לי and if I call, ye will hoist me up; (Koh. R. to IX, 10 שרר; Mat. K. quotes גדש, v. גְּדַשׁ II).
Sifra Vayikra, N’dabah, ch. XIV, Par. 13 אפשר יקלנו ג' I might think he must roast it after being pounded; Men. 66 b
Targ. Y. Lev. II, 14; 16 Levita (ed. פירוכ').

definicoes_originais: (γῆ κρητική, creta) chalk, white earth used for cleansing silver ware.
notas_originais: Sabb. 50 a גרתי' Ar. (ed. גרתקון, גרתקין); Y. Bets. IV, 62 c bot. קרטי'; Tosef. ib. IV, 10 קירטון ed. Zuck. (Var. קרקתין, קרתתין). [Rashi to Sabb. l. c. expl. אלום, describing tartar deposited in wine vessels; Ar.: pulverised resin.]
, v. נְגַשׁ

definicoes_originais: (גשש), ג' של ספינה prob. framework of a ship (v. גָּשִׁישׁ); comment.: sounding pole.
notas_originais: Sabb. 125 b (Ms. M. אגושש, Ms. O. גשיש; v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Contus).

one tracing treasures buried in the ground.

— Pl. גְּשׁוֹשָׁאֵי. B. Mets. 42 a

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גּוּשׁ, גָּשַׁשׁ; formado como עָצִיץ) [; aparelho de som, v. גָּשׁוֹשׁ.; uma moldura sobre a qual o sofá é estendido (sponda).
definicoes_originais: a frame on which the couch is spread (sponda).
notas_originais: Zab. III, 1; 3 ג' של מטה; Tosef. ib. IV, 4. Ib. Mikv. VI (VII), 17 הג' החיצון the outer frame (of a double bed, sponda exterior, v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Lectus). Esth. R. to I, 6.— Pl. גָּשִׁישִׁים, גָּשִׁישִׁין. Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VIII, 3 הג' של קיטליזקי (ed. Zuck. קיטליאקי, read ס for א) the bed-frames of the little bed chambers (κοιτωνίσκοι—which are taken apart or placed against the wall in day time).—*Tosef. Mikv. VI, 8 ג' ע"ג השבר Ar. (ed. קשקשים, Sabb. 53 a קשישין) splints

verbetes.glosa_atual: v. גּוּשׁ) tornar a terra turva (v. Ges. H. Dict. 10 s. v.).; (denominação de גֶּשֶׁם) estar repleto de chuva, trazendo chuva.
definicoes_originais: v. גּוּשׁ) to make the earth cloddy (v. Ges. H. Dict. 10 s. v.).
(denom. of גֶּשֶׁם) to be frought with rain, rain-bringing.
notas_originais: — Part. pass. גָּשׁוּם cloddy in consequence of ample rains. Y. Yoma V, 42 c top שנת גְּשׁוּמָה שחונה וכ' (sub. ארץ) a year in which the earth forms clods, then is parched so as to form scabs, and then moistened with dew; Bab. ib. 53 b שנת שחונה שנת ג' Ms. M. (ed. שנה ג' ושח', v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note), expl. אם שח' (היא) תהא ג' if it is to be parched, let it first be soaked with heavy rains; Lev. R. s. 20; Tanḥ. Aḥăré 3 (corr. acc.); ed. Bub. ib. 4.
B. Bath. 25 b since the destruction of the Temple לא הוּגְשְׁמָה וכ' the south wind has not been rain-bringing.

Taan. 3 b לא אמר מוריד הַגָּ' if he failed to insert in the second benediction (v. גְּבוּרָה) ‘Who sendeth rain’.— Pl. גְּשָׁמִים. Taan. I, 1, a. fr. גבורות ג', v. גְּבוּרָה. Ib. 2 שואלין את הג' we insert the petition for rain in the ninth benediction, v. שַׁאֲלָה.—ימות הג' rainy season, autumn and winter. Ib. 3 b. Toh. VI, 7, v. בִּקְעָה; a. v. fr.—שְׂדֵה גְ' (or sub. שדה) a field naturally watered by rain, opp. שלחין. Bekh. VI, 3 של ג' from fields with natural irrigation; cmp. בַּעַל. [In later Hebr. literature גֶּשֶׁם substance, v. next w.].
Dan. IV, 30.— Pl. גִּשְׁמַיָּא. Lam. R. to I, 5 לא יהבין גִּשְׁמֵיהוֹן (Koh. R. to VII, 11 גרמיהון) they will not devote themselves to warfare.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. precedente, cmp. גָּשִׁישׁ) moldura, batente de porta contra o qual a porta se fecha.
definicoes_originais: (v. preced., cmp. גָּשִׁישׁ) frame, door-stop against which the door shuts.
notas_originais: Erub. 101 a (explain. ‘a widowed door’) דלית לה ג' (Ms. M. בשמא, a clerical error for כשמא, oth. Var. גְּשָׁאמָא, כְּשָׁאמָא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note; גִּישְׁתְּמָא, reduplic. of גשם, cmp. גזוזטרא, v. Ar. ed. Koh. s. v. גשם) which does not shut against a frame.
, Men. 50 b איגשף Ar., v. נְשַׁף, נְשַׁב.
, v. גּוּשְׁקְרָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. גשש) para ingressar, esp. para fazer uma ponte.
definicoes_originais: (v. גשש) to join, esp. to make a bridge.
notas_originais: Ab. Zar. 2 b הרבה גשרים גָּשַׁרְנוּ we have built numerous bridges.

verbetes.glosa_atual: B. Kam. 113 b קטילי … וגַשְׁרֵי גִשְׁרֵי eles (os funcionários do governo) derrubaram árvores (pertencentes a particulares) e construíram pontes.
notas_originais: B. Kam. 113 b קטילי … וגַשְׁרֵי גִשְׁרֵי they (the government officials) fell trees (belonging to private persons) and build bridges.

Erub. 55 b; Tosef. ib. VI (V), 4 הקבר והג' וכ' graves and bridges (in the outskirts of towns) which have a place of shelter.—Gen. R. s. 76, end עשה עצמו כג' וכ' Jacob constituted himself a ferry, taking persons from one shore and setting them down on the other (Mat. K. כגַשָּׁר like a ferry-man).— Pl. גְּשָׁרִים, גְּשָׁרִין. Erub. V, 1. Ib. IX, 4 ג' המפולשים bridges under which there is an open passage. Ab. Zar. 2 b; a. fr.
— Pl. גִּשְׁרִין. Targ. Ezek. XXVII, 5 Levita (ed. גִּשְׁרִיךְ, גִּשְׁרָךְ).

Ber. 59 b he who sees the Euphrates אג' דבבל from the bridge (or ferry) of Babylon; a. fr.— Pl. גִּשְׁרַיָּא, גִּשְׁרֵי, גִּיֹשְ'. Targ. Y. I Ex. XX, 26. Targ. Nah. II, 7 (h. text שערי).—B. Kam. 113 b, v. גְּשַׁר. B. Bath. 73 b.—[Sabb. 67 a top וז' סיכי מז' גָּשׁוֹרֵי (Ms. M. גשרי)—prob. a Var. of preceding וז' ציבי מז' כשורי, v. כָּשׁוֹרָא.]

notas_originais: Ḥall. II, 2; Y. ib. 58 c top הספינה גוֹשֶׁשֶׁת the ship touches the ground (in harbor).
Y. Yoma V, 42 c היה מְגַשֵּׁשׁ וכ' entered groping &c.
Lev. R. s. 8 (ref. to Jud. XIII, 25, cmp. פַּעֲמֹן) התחיל רוה"ק לגַשְׁגֵּשׁ וכ' the holy spirit began to ring in Samson.
הִתְגּוֹשֵׁשׁ, Hithpalp. הִתְגַּשְׁגֵּשׁ, Nithpa. נִתְגַּשֵּׁשׁ
. Gen. R. s. 22; s. 77; Cant. R. to III, 6. Ex. R. s. 28, beg.
Pesik. S’liḥoth. p. 166 a גבור שהוא מִתְגּוֹשֵׁש וכ' a warrior practicing on a stone-cutter’s stone.

definicoes_originais: Pa. גַּשֵּׁשׁ same, to feel, touch.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Gen. XXVII, 12; 22 (h. text מוש). Gitt. 67 b bot. גַּשְּׁשֵׁיה he (being blind) touched it (and felt the bone).
Ḥull. 47 b resembling wood בג' in touch. Ib. 122 b; Sabb. 107 b

verbetes.glosa_atual: (precedido; cmp. גָּשׁוֹשָׁא) tubo de sondagem; ג' ובת ג' um tubo grande e pequeno, ou seja, um sifão.
definicoes_originais: (preced.; cmp. גָּשׁוֹשָׁא) sounding tube; ג' ובת ג' a large and small tube, i.e. a siphon.
notas_originais: Ab. Zar. 72 b אסיק חמרא בג' brought up wine through the siphon. Ib. a gentile came and put his hand אג' on the large tube. Ib. אג' … גריר, v. גְּרַר.
Snh. 102 a; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , com sufixo גִּתּ־, גִּיתּ־ (contr. de גֶּנֶת) um espaço marcado.
definicoes_originais: , with suffix גִּתּ־, גִּיתּ־ (contr. of גֶּנֶת) a marked-off space.
notas_originais: Tosef. Ohol. XV, 7 ‘the court of a burying place’ זו הגת … לתוכה (R. S. to Ohol. XV, 8, ed. Zuck. לתוכו, Var. גל) is the marked space into which the caverns open.—Par. IV, 2 שרפה חוץ מגִּתָּהּ if he burnt the cow outside of the place selected for the purpose; Zeb. XIV, 1; Tosef. Par. III, 9 sq.— Pl. גִּתּוֹת, גִּיתּ'. Par. l. c.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , com sufixo גִּתּ־, גִּיתּ־ (b. h.; contr. de גגת, cmp. גִּיגִּית) cuba para prensagem de vinho; (שעת)הג' a estação da prensagem do vinho.
definicoes_originais: , with suffix גִּתּ־, גִּיתּ־ (b. h.; contr. of גגת, cmp. גִּיגִּית) vat for wine pressing ; (שעת)הג' the season of wine pressing.
notas_originais: Ab. Zar. V, 11 ג' של אבן a stone vat, של חרס an earthen. Ib. IV, 8, v. בָּעַט. Ḥag. III, 4 (24 b) מניחה לג' הבאה he may reserve it for the next season (and give it to the priest). Ib. 25 b דבר שאין לו ג' something which has no special manufacturing season (e.g. date wine); a. fr.—Lam. R. introd. 32 (play on מבליגֹיֹתֹיֹ, Jer. VIII, 18) עשיתי לביתי גִּותִּי I made my house my vat (cmp. Lam. I, 15).— Pl. גִּיתּוֹת, גִּתּ'.—בית הגי' the press room. Tosef. Ter. III, 7; Y. ib. II, 41 b bot. בית הגיתי' (corr. acc.)—Tosef. l. c. שתי ג' לבור וכ' two vats for one pit; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (denominação de precedente) mulher que trabalhava no lagar, pisadora de vinho.
definicoes_originais: (denom. of preced.) woman engaged in the wine press, wine treader.
notas_originais: — Pl. גִּתִּיּוֹת, גִּיתִּ'. Gen. R. s. 71 [read:] אף הג' מאחורי הקוריים וכ' even the wine-treaders behind the beam handlers (of loose character) maligned her. Esth. R. to I, 10 (play on א̇ב̇ג̇ת̇א) א̇ב̇יא ג̇ית̇' מא' ק' I shall bring the wine treaders &c. (to deride her).

verbetes.glosa_atual: Daleth, a quarta letra do Alfabeto; ele troca dialeticamente com ז, por ex. זב, דב; com צ, por ex. אֶדְבַּע, אֶצְבַּע.
definicoes_originais: Daleth, the fourth letter of the Alphabet; it interchanges dialectically with ז, e.g. זב, דב; with צ, e.g. אֶדְבַּע, אֶצְבַּע.
notas_originais: —ד eliminated in אוּנָּא = אוּדְנָא, קַמָּא = קַדְמָא.

definicoes_originais: as a numeral, four, v. א'.

verbetes.glosa_atual: um prefixo, corresp. para h. שֶׁ־, de, quem, qual, aquilo (quod).
definicoes_originais: a prefix, corresp. to h. שֶׁ־, of, who, which, that (quod).
notas_originais: Targ. Gen. XXXI, 42. Ib. IX, 5; a. v. fr.—Ber. 2 a זמן ק"ש דשכיבה the time of reading the Sh’ma of bed-time (Deut. VI, 7). Ib. ליתני דערבית וכ' let him first state that of (the law concerning) the evening prayer. Ib. הא קמ"ל דכפרה וכ' we are given to understand (by implication) that &c. Ib. ממאי דהאי וכ' whence is it proved that this uba &c.? Ib. b ואינהו דמחשכי וכ' and it was they who (as an exception) worked late and early; a. v. fr.—[This prefix is used for the formation of what may be named Difel nouns, as דְּבֵיתָא, דִּכְמָא &c., a. Dispeel nouns as דִּיסְקַרְתָּא &c.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: (= h. זוֹ, זֹאת) isto; com prefixo ה, (הֲדָא) הָדָא, cmp. אָדָא I.
definicoes_originais: (= h. זוֹ, זֹאת) this; with prefix ה, (הֲדָא) הָדָא, cmp. אָדָא I.
notas_originais: Targ. Gen. II, 23; a. fr.—Ned. 41 a (prov.) דְּדָא ביה וכ' in whom there is this (wisdom), in him there is everything.—דא ודא this and that, both. Sabb. 52 b ד' וד' (אחת) חדא היא all sorts of rings come under the same law; a. fr.—Y. Succ. I, 52 c top הדא אמרה היא הדא וכ' this proves &c., v. אָדָא I.—הדא היא דכתיב (abbr. הה"ד) it is this which Scripture says, thus we read. Y. Sot. I, 17 b bot.; Gen. R. s. 2; a. v. fr.—Y. Gitt. IV, 45 d bot. introduced his lecture בדה with this.—לא בְדָא not in this case, i.e. the law does not apply to this. Y. Ber. I, 2 b bot.; a. fr.—Y. Taan. II, 66 a bot. לא בדא הלכה וכ' not in this case is the practice in agreement with the anonymous opinion.

verbetes.glosa_atual: da da, o chamado dos condutores de camelos.
notas_originais: Pes. 112 b. [דא, Cant. R. to II, 15, v. בלטוורא.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: derreter, definhar, definhar.; derreter, fazer definhar.
definicoes_originais: to melt, to cause to languish.
notas_originais: B. Bath. 79 a (play on מידבא, Num. XXI, 30) עד שתַּדְאִיב נשמתן (Var. תדיב, תדוב, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 2) until it (the fire of Gehenna) shall melt their soul. Ned. 22 a (ref. to Deut. XXVIII, 65) שמכלה … ומַדְאִיב וכ' which ruins the eyesight and makes life languid. Ch. דְּאֵיב.
Targ. Y. II Deut. XXVIII, 65.

same. Targ. Job XLI, 14 (דאב' fem., h. text דאבה).—Targ. Ps. XIII, 3 דב' Ms. (ed. דוו'; h. text יגון). Targ. Y. Num. XXI, 30 בִּדְבוֹ' (some ed. כְּדָ', h. text דיבון, cmp. B. Bath. 79 a, s. v. דָּאַב); a. e.
Targ. Prov. XVIII, 8 מְדַאַבְנָן ed. Lag. (oth. ed. מרכנן, h. text כמתלהמים).
, v. דּוֹאֵג

verbetes.glosa_atual: (bh) [derreter,] cmp. דאב a. יצף, ser desanimado, tristeza, medo.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) [ to melt,] cmp. דאב a. יצף, to be low-spirited, to sorrow, fear.
notas_originais: Snh. 106 b (play on דאג, I Sam. XXI, 8, a. דוֹיֹג, ib. XXII, 18) at first יושב הקב"ה ודוֹאֵג וכ' the Lord sat in anxiety, that he (Doeg) might degenerate; after …, He said ו̇וי̇ שיצא זה woe that he did &c. Ber. 40 a יִדְאַג מריח וכ' must be in fear of contracting &c. Succ. 29 a. Ḥag. 13 a שלבו דואג בקרבו whose heart within him is in fear of sin (reverential). Sabb. 105 b sq. יִדְאֲגוּ כל האחין all the brothers should feel troubled (examine their ways). Midr. Till. to Ps. XLVIII a man committed a sin והיה דואג בלבו and was troubled in his heart; a. fr.
